sources.snippet: CafeBERT is a large-scale multilingual language model with strong support for Vietnamese. The model is based on XLM-Roberta (the state-of-the-art multilingual language model) and is enhanced with a large Vietnamese corpus with many domains: ...

sources.title: BaoNhan/cafebert-vifn · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: cafebert-vifn This model is uitnlp/CafeBERT fine-tuned for binary Vietnamese fake-news classification on the text-only ViFN benchmark.
